answer.label: fine-tune bias
answer.justification: Only logit-level data is available, and it matches fine-tune bias closely. The decisive value is the raw-score shift ÷ TV of 11.3 ×10⁵: the document gives 10.4 for fine-tune bias against 2.3–3.9 for every other class. The other logit values fit as well: KL 0.080 (fine-tune bias 0.082), TV 0.083 (0.082), top-1 agreement 0.926 (0.935), sequence agreement 0.547 (0.583) and Token-DiFR gap 0.243 (0.219). Quantization is ruled out by its smaller raw-score shift (2.3) and higher top-1 agreement (0.951). Fine-tune backdoor has a higher KL (0.15) and a raw-score shift of only 3.3. Both system-prompt classes have KL of 0.24 or more. Confidence is held below 0.9 because no activation or text evidence was available to confirm.
